pages.title: Living Reload
pages.text: Both living weapons require real refilling and use.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: An inflated mosquito supplies Blood Sacs and proboscis. Feeding on a warped fungal creature mutates it into Warped Mosco; muscle and sacs support the upgrade. Neither weapon nor rare-creature drops is gifted for a click.
